image_pattern_summary: Verified good images for industrial shed fabrication show either the completed exterior of a steel-clad shed (colour-coated PPGI/PPGL panels in grey/blue, visible structural columns, gable or single-slope roof) or the interior of a completed shed (clear-span roof structure, corrugated cladding, natural skylights, structural columns). A third common pattern is the shed under active construction — MS/steel columns erected, roof purlins in place, cladding partially installed, workers visible on site. All good images are real-site photographs, not renders or brochures.

reason: Industrial shed fabrication is a construction service — the image IS the proof of capability, showing scale, structural system, cladding quality, and finish level that buyers evaluate.
Good images consistently show real completed or in-progress projects with identifiable structural elements (columns, purlins, cladding type, roof shape) that convey technical competence.
OCR is marginally useful only for company watermarks/logos visible in images; the primary information is visual (structural scale, material quality, finish) not text-extractable.
